dimensions.assessment: The population affected is limited to specific living victims of Libyan state-sponsored terrorism who meet precise employment and court claimant criteria.
dimensions.evidence: an individual who--(1) is a United States person;--(2) was 45 years of age or older on December 3, 1991;--(3) was employed by Pan American World Airways, Inc.

dimensions.assessment: The financial compensation distributed among the qualified claimants represents a moderate to major direct economic effect for each individual beneficiary.
dimensions.evidence: shall be entitled to an award in an amount equal to--(A) $42,066,338, divided by--(B) the total number of claims certified

dimensions.assessment: The bill appropriates a specific sum of $42,066,338 from the Treasury to fund the claims trust fund.
dimensions.evidence: there shall be appropriated to the Fund, out of any money in the Treasury of the United States not otherwise appropriated, $42,066,338

dimensions.assessment: The bill creates a temporary claims trust fund and directs specific administrative duties to the Secretary of the Treasury and the Foreign Claims Settlement Commission.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of the Treasury shall establish, in the Treasury of the United States, a trust fund, to be known as the `Living Victims of Lockerbie Claims Trust Fund'

dimensions.assessment: The funding remains available until expended to pay the defined claims, providing a one-time compensation mechanism that concludes once processed.
dimensions.evidence: to remain available until expended, which shall be made available to provide compensation

importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a trust fund with an appropriation of $42,066,338 to compensate specific living U.S. citizens who were victims of Libyan state-sponsored terrorism and employed by Pan American World Airways on December 3, 1991.
